thesis:
本期纳入一项10月26日产品公告及三项最近七天、此前未覆盖的研究与工程材料。共同判断是：批准、记忆和恢复都不是一次性事件。配置迁移必须绑定具体变更，故障恢复必须区分“再执行”与“查清已发生的结果”，正常办公请求也可能越过未写在提示中的边界；经验记忆能提高重复表现，却未必降低成本。本期没有可独立复现的生产ROI结论。

四组材料揭示的是四种不同的“继续条件”：迁移包是否获准、旧动作是否已经发生、沟通对象是否适当、历史经验是否仍符合当前政策。它们应保存在可检查的业务状态里，而不是揉进一个模型置信分。检索到规则不等于遵守规则，保存检查点不等于保存外部真相，模型记住的经验也不自动获得正式政策地位。

证据层级不能混合：Oracle证明了公开产品设计；重试论文提供有限一致性反例但没有公开全套执行代码；BARC有人工抽检但数据链接仍不完整；IBM有代码与对照，却没有真人生产收益。共同可行动的结论是先记录“谁批准了什么、哪次效果已确认、未知由谁处理”，再决定增加多少自治。
takeaways: 批准应绑定变更对象，不是绑定一个Agent。 Oracle公布了迁移报告与批准后执行，却没有版本漂移和回滚数据；企业验收必须检查审批后的实际配置是否仍与批准对象一致，不能只确认出现过审批按钮。
恢复成功不等于重新执行成功。 重试研究42例通过中只有21例确认完成，正确拒绝与保留未知同样计入通过。复盘应分别统计合法完成、拒绝和未决义务，不能用合规总分掩盖挂起积压。
正常请求也需要内容与受众边界。 BARC-Bench的五次全安全指标包含转问用户，且题目刻意具备风险；它支持增设日历与消息预览，不支持把27.3%外推为日常事故率或把拒绝率当业务价值。
经验条数不是记忆质量。 IBM航空实验中14条规则比101条更可靠，零售完整规则又增加65%评测会话费用；应按领域联合测重复可靠性、复核负担与成本，不直接复制“更多记忆”的配置。
contrarian:
主流直觉是：更多记忆、更积极重试与更少转人工，会让Agent更有用。来源事实给出的反例是： IBM航空规则扩充后四次全成功下降；重试实验即使重新验证权限仍可能重复退款；BARC的无伤害转问并不等于完成任务。Oracle的治理承诺也还没有效果分母。

编辑判断： 对不可逆写入、结果不透明的外部接口和涉及他人隐私的协作，少执行一次、保留未知或主动转人，可能比快速“完成”更有净价值。成立条件是误动作损失高于等待与复核成本，且未决事项有负责人和处理时限；这不适用于无限挂起。

推翻条件： 在独立留出任务和真实影子流量中，积极恢复或扩充记忆能持续减少严重错误，同时提高最终合法完成率、降低人工与等待总成本，并证明不会重复执行或扩大受众，就应增加自动化。单次演示、榜单名次与包含拒绝的安全率不足以推翻该判断。

items.title: Oracle把CPQ配置迁移拆成可审报告与批准后执行，尚无客户效果分母
items.type: 产品公告＋执行治理架构＋配置发布工作流
items.source: 2026年10月26日｜Oracle；关联运行时于9月29日发布
items.summary: Oracle新公告中最具体的窄任务之一，是把报价配置从测试环境迁移到生产：系统先汇集迁移包声明的变更与依赖，生成可审阅报告，识别潜在问题，再在授予的权限内执行已批准步骤。这里值得借鉴的是把“准备发布”和“获准发布”分开，而非让Agent自行决定全量上线。需要校正时间线：Fusion Claw运行时及25款应用的总体发布早在9月29日，本期新增关注的是10月26日列出的迁移用途与审批边界，不能将整套平台包装成刚刚诞生的技术。应先验证报告是否准确对应最终上线对象。
items.design: 公告给出的输入是配置迁移包及其声明的变更、依赖；Agent准备检查报告，人员批准后，执行层在授权范围内实施迁移。关联架构把模型推理与确定性计算分开，以组织目标、政策、权限、风险阈值和升级边界定义运行包络，并用执行回执记录依据与动作。这是厂商描述，不是审计结果。具体模型路由、依赖检索方法、对象级权限、批准绑定哈希、超时重试和部分迁移回滚均未披露。编辑建议在依赖缺失或版本漂移时停止，由发布负责人重审，不把原批准沿用到修改后的迁移包。
items.evidence: 证据等级：厂商发布与架构自述，尚无独立效果验证。 可确认的是两份公告的日期及明确描述的“报告—审批—执行”用途；“可规模化、经济地完成复杂工作”仍是厂商主张。25款应用是产品数量，不是部署客户数、成功迁移数或质量样本。尚未证明： 没有配置包数量、依赖漏检、批准后变更、失败回滚、发布周期、人工复核时间及总费用；也未给出迁移前后对照。编辑判断是该流程适合作为验收清单，但不能证明报告覆盖全部隐式依赖，更不能据平台具有治理框架就认为生产写入已安全。实际租户可用范围和合同条件仍需部署前核对，也缺少独立审计者对执行回执的抽样核验。
items.idea: 为维护报价系统的发布人员做“迁移包只读预检”：仅解析一个产品线的配置差异、依赖与目标版本，生成报告而不连接生产写接口；负责人逐项批准。以依赖召回、误报、版本漂移检出、审阅分钟数、返工率和演练回滚成功率验收，先观察两周，不扩展自动部署。

items.title: 重试前重新查权限仍会重复退款，恢复必须保留外部结果的不确定性
items.type: 新预印本＋双执行宿主故障实验＋公开结果表
items.summary: Permission to Retry研究退款已经落地、确认响应却丢失时该怎样恢复；此时用户权限还可能已经撤销。恢复检查点不能证明退款没发生，沿用相同请求键也不能保证服务端永远去重。作者把再次写入的许可、历史结果证据和只读对账权限拆开，比较四种应用恢复策略。最有用的结论不是某工作流框架胜出，而是：有权限重试也可能付两次，失去写权限也不一定禁止核对旧结果；无法确认的动作应保留未决义务，而不是为了显示完成就释放占用或再发一次。
items.design: 实验以一个合成退款为输入，将主体、动作、政策版本、期限与允许效果次数绑定；调度器控制响应丢失、延迟提交和撤权，检查器读取应用不可见的外部效果账。LangGraph与Temporal只负责各自持久化和恢复，不决定业务授权。保留账本策略只查旧结果：有持久确认即结算，没有充分证据就保持预留，不再次派发。审批事实均由脚本提供，没有真实模型或人员参与。编辑建议生产中将未知状态交财务人员，只读对账使用单独权限，超时冻结新写入；论文未验证真实身份服务竞态或付款渠道补偿。
items.evidence: 证据等级：有限、确定性一致性实验；预印本，非完整公开复现。 共336条历史，覆盖两宿主、14种时序、三类服务契约、四种应用策略；168对宿主单元结果一致。每宿主每策略42例，缓存重试、重查权限、稳定键分别通过30、36、31例；账本对账42例通过，其中仅21例确认完成，15例正确拒绝、6例保持未知。局限： 这不是100%任务完成；策略和检查器同项目开发，单一合成退款、无真实IAM或支付；完整执行代码未公开，仅结果表可检查。两宿主相同不代表默认框架存在漏洞，也不能把人工构造时序比例当生产事故率。通过集合由固定脚本构成，无法估计真实退款流量的风险频率，也没有跨组织外部验证。
items.idea: 为退款运营团队做不接真实资金的恢复演练，固定三类接口契约，注入响应丢失、撤权及晚到确认；只有持久回执才能结算，未知交财务复核，不自动重发。测重复效果、撤权后新派发、错误完成声明、未决保留率和人工对账分钟数，并给挂起事项设置负责人和期限。

items.title: BARC-Bench：正常办公请求也会越界，27.3%不是单次事故率
items.type: 新安全基准预印本＋模拟工作区＋人工校准的模型评委
items.source: 2026年10月23日提交，10月26日新论文列表可见｜Scale AI

relatedLinks.label: 全文、模型配置与评分口径

items.summary: BARC-Bench不要求用户发恶意指令，而测试“安排离职讨论”“清理重复文件”等正常请求：会议可以成功创建，却因共享标题提前泄露离职信息；两份看似重复的文件也可能保留不同处理结论。系统必须从工作区记录及语境发现边界，而非只服从最新一句话。研究把安全完成、无伤害地转问用户和已经造成伤害分开，强调后来补救不能抹除先前越界。对企业的价值是把评测从攻击提示扩到日常协作错误，尤其是收件人、可见范围与敏感细节，而不是只测工具是否调用成功。
items.design: 九个合成工作区包含消息、日历、文档和记录，Agent代表员工检索证据并调用工具；任务级规则描述该场景禁止的伤害。四个模型配置各运行五次，评委读取轨迹、产物与最终状态，只要出现伤害便判不安全；没有伤害但未完成的澄清也算安全，而不算任务完成。人工参与环境审查和评委校准，并非在线接管。论文没有实现生产身份隔离、字段级外发门或撤权恢复。编辑建议对日历标题、附件和收件人另设预览审批；对象歧义或可见范围不明时停问用户，不让模型推断代替授权。
items.evidence: 证据等级：合成受控基准与人工一致性抽检，尚未独立复现。 110题、四配置、每题五次；全部五次无伤害的题目比例为72.7%、37.3%、23.6%、9.1%，依次对应GPT‑6 Astra、Claude-Fable 5.1、Gemini 3.8-Flash、DeepSeek V4-Pro。最好配置在27.3%题目至少一次越界，不是27.3%调用会出事。300条轨迹上，评委与人类多数票一致90.0%。局限： 种子刻意选择能诱发失败的任务，存在选择偏差；规范主要来自美国研究者与工程师，安全包含转问用户，不能解释为完成率。论文数据发布处仍为占位文字；框架开源不等于本基准数据已可完整复现。模型还参与合成与筛选，可能偏向自身能识别的风险；人工一致性不代表题库之外的企业准则，跨文化与多轮适用性仍需进一步验证。
items.idea: 为行政和HR团队建立30题合成日历与文档协作集，不使用真实离职或绩效信息；同时检查事项完成、收件范围和敏感内容，五次重复中任一次严重泄露即阻止扩量。人员裁决边界并接管歧义，测安全完成、合理转问、误阻断和复核工时，记录争议题并单独复审。

items.title: IBM用经验规则提高客服重复成功率，但更多记忆会增加成本并降低部分可靠性
items.type: 工程实验博客＋开源经验学习库＋公开基准提交
items.summary: IBM没有修改模型权重，而从客服Agent在训练任务中的成功和失败轨迹提取短规则，追加到后续会话提示中。例如，先验证客户身份、更新数据库前要求明确确认、等待工具结果后再答复。研究保留原客服流程与工具，只改变经验规则，便于观察记忆的增量。值得注意的不是“旧模型夺冠”，而是同一规则剂量并不通用：零售需要较完整经验，航空却在少量高支持规则下更稳定。企业可先把反复发生的局部错误变成受审查的操作规则，不必马上增加新Agent或训练新权重。
items.design: 训练轨迹经同一个GPT‑4.1提炼、合并为经验，每条附出现过的不同训练任务数；测试时原样追加到政策之后，不读取留出题答案。ReAct客服Agent与模拟客户对话，工具处理订单或机票，最终数据库状态判定完成；规则仍只是提示，不是确定性权限门。研究未部署真人客服、真实IAM、人工审批队列或异常恢复。编辑建议先限定退货咨询和退款草稿，政策所有者批准规则版本，保留原政策优先级；规则冲突、身份验证失败、超时及低置信建议都转人，禁止自动写回经验覆盖正式政策。
items.evidence: 证据等级：厂商受控实验、开放代码与提交记录；无独立生产复现。 留出零售40题、航空20题，各试四次；GPT‑4.1四次全成功比例分别由57.5%升至67.5%、35%升至45%。航空14条高支持规则达45%，全部101条反降至40%。完整基准上的零售每会话费用由0.084升至0.139美元，增加65%，含Agent与模拟客户，不能当真人客服成本。局限： 小样本、合成客户、无置信区间或客户损失结果；排行榜使用训练加测试全集，不能与留出集混用。代码及PR增加可检查性，不等于第三方复验；提示缓存节省仍是待生产验证的主张。还需计入规则生成、维护和升级费用；轮次减少仅在双方都答对的配对样本计算，不能直接证明全部请求更快。
items.idea: 为退货客服主管做“十条可撤回经验”试点，仅从已脱敏且人工纠正的案例提取建议，由政策负责人批准后用于草稿。对相同留出工单比较无记忆、十条及全部规则，测四次全成功、政策冲突、误退款建议、人工修改时间和每个合格答复总成本，失败时撤回规则。

projectIdeas.title: 迁移批准与恢复账本
projectIdeas.description: 目标用户为报价系统发布人员，最小范围是一个测试产品线的配置包；保存包哈希、依赖快照、批准人、派发记录和效果回执。发布负责人处理漂移与未决状态，Agent不能自行重发。验证批准对象一致率、重复执行、未决超时、演练回滚和每次合格发布总工时。

projectIdeas.title: 带边界的客服经验库
projectIdeas.description: 目标用户为退货客服主管，最小范围是十条脱敏经验和只读答复草稿；政策负责人审核、版本化并可一键撤回，敏感外发或退款均交人。用固定留出集重复测试规则剂量，验证安全完成、四次全成功、合理升级、政策冲突与含复核的单案成本。

en.thesis:
This issue includes one October 26 product announcement and three previously uncovered research and engineering materials from the past seven days. The shared conclusion is that approval, memory and recovery are not one-off events. Configuration migration must be tied to specific changes; recovery must distinguish dispatching again from establishing what already happened; ordinary workplace requests can cross boundaries absent from the prompt. Experience-based memory can improve repeatability without necessarily lowering costs. None of these materials establishes independently reproduced production ROI.

The four sources describe different conditions for proceeding: whether a migration package is approved, whether an earlier action already happened, whether the communication audience is appropriate, and whether past experience still respects current policy. These belong in inspectable business state, not a single model confidence score. Retrieving a rule is not applying it, a checkpoint is not external truth, and remembered experience does not automatically become formal policy.

Evidence tiers must remain separate: Oracle documents a product design; the retry paper supplies finite conformance counterexamples without full public execution code; BARC includes human checks but an incomplete data link; IBM supplies code and comparisons without real-customer production benefits. Record who approved what, which effects are confirmed, and who owns uncertainty before adding autonomy.
takeaways: Approval should bind to the change, not to an Agent. Oracle describes migration reports and post-approval execution but supplies no version-drift or rollback results. Acceptance must verify that the actual configuration still matches the approved object, not merely that an approval button appeared.

Recovery success is not successful re-execution. Only 21 of the retry study’s 42 passing histories were checked completions; correct denials and retained uncertainty also passed. Report legitimate completion, denial and unresolved obligations separately instead of hiding backlog behind an aggregate conformance score.

Benign requests still need content and audience boundaries. BARC’s all-five-safe metric includes deferral, and its tasks were deliberately risky. It supports calendar and message previews, not extrapolating 27.3% to daily incidents or treating refusal as business value.

Rule count is not memory quality. IBM’s 14-rule airline configuration was more reliable than its 101-rule version, while full retail guidance increased evaluation conversation costs by 65%. Measure repeated reliability, review burden and cost by domain rather than copying a more-memory configuration.
en.contrarian:
The mainstream intuition is that more memory, more active retries and fewer human escalations make Agents more useful. Source counterexamples: IBM’s expanded airline rules reduced all-four success; retrying after rechecking authority could still duplicate refunds; BARC’s harmless deferral is not completed work. Oracle’s governance promises likewise lack outcome denominators.

Editorial judgment: for irreversible writes, opaque external outcomes and collaboration involving another person’s privacy, executing once less, retaining uncertainty or escalating can have greater net value than rapidly declaring completion. This applies when error losses exceed waiting and review costs and unresolved work has an owner and deadline; it does not justify indefinite suspension.

What would overturn this judgment: independent held-out tasks and real shadow traffic showing that more active recovery or memory consistently reduces severe errors, improves final authorized completion, and lowers combined human and waiting costs without duplicate effects or expanded audiences. A demo, leaderboard rank or a safety score that includes refusal is insufficient.

items.type: Product announcement + execution-governance architecture + configuration-release workflow
items.source: October 26, 2026 | Oracle; related runtime announced September 29
items.title: Oracle separates CPQ migration reports from approved execution, without customer outcome denominators
items.summary: One of the narrowest tasks in Oracle’s new announcement is moving quoting configuration from test to production. The application assembles a reviewable report of a migration package’s declared changes and dependencies, identifies potential problems, and executes approved steps within provided authority. The useful separation is between preparing a release and being authorized to release, rather than letting an Agent decide a full rollout. The timeline matters: the Fusion Claw runtime and the overall set of 25 applications were announced on September 29. This issue focuses on the migration use case and approval boundary described on October 26, not a claim that the whole platform has just appeared. First verify that the report corresponds to what actually reaches production.
items.design: The stated inputs are a configuration migration package and its declared changes and dependencies. The Agent prepares a review report; following human approval, execution proceeds within granted authority. The related architecture separates model reasoning from deterministic computation, defines an operating envelope using objectives, policies, permissions, risk thresholds and escalation boundaries, and records evidence and actions in an outcome receipt. These are vendor descriptions, not audit findings. Model routing, dependency retrieval, object-level authorization, approval-to-hash binding, timeout retries and partial-migration rollback are undisclosed. Editorial recommendation: stop on missing dependencies or version drift and have the release owner reapprove; never carry the old approval onto a modified package.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: vendor announcement and architecture description, without independent effectiveness validation. The announcement dates and the explicitly described report–approval–execution use case are verifiable; economical, large-scale execution of complex work remains a vendor claim. Twenty-five applications is a product count, not a customer, successful-migration or quality sample. Unproven: package counts, missed dependencies, post-approval changes, rollback failures, release-cycle time, review time and total cost; there is no before/after migration comparison. Editorial judgment: use the workflow as an acceptance checklist, not proof that reports capture every implicit dependency or that governed production writes are safe. Tenant availability and contract terms still require predeployment checks, and independent sampling of execution receipts is missing.
items.idea: For quoting-system release staff, build a read-only migration precheck for one product line. Parse configuration differences, dependencies and target versions into a report, without a production write connection; the owner approves each item. Evaluate dependency recall, false positives, version-drift detection, review minutes, rework and rehearsal rollback success over two weeks before adding automatic deployment.

items.type: New preprint + fault experiments on two execution hosts + published outcome tables
items.title: Rechecking authority before a retry can still duplicate refunds; recovery must preserve uncertainty
items.summary: Permission to Retry studies recovery when a refund has committed but its acknowledgement is lost, potentially after the user’s write authority is revoked. Restoring a checkpoint does not prove no refund happened, and a stable request key does not guarantee permanent server-side deduplication. The authors separate permission for another write, evidence of an earlier effect and read-only reconciliation, comparing four application recovery policies. The practical lesson is not that one workflow framework wins: an authorized retry can still pay twice, while loss of write authority need not forbid checking an old result. Unconfirmed actions should retain their outstanding obligation rather than release a reservation or dispatch again just to display completion.
items.design: A synthetic refund binds principal, action, policy epoch, expiry and allowed effect count. A scheduler controls lost responses, delayed commitment and revocation; the checker reads an external effect ledger hidden from the application. LangGraph and Temporal supply persistence and recovery, not business authorization. The retained-ledger policy only reconciles previous deliveries: settle on durable confirmation, otherwise retain the reservation without redispatch. Approvals are scripted facts, not real model or human decisions. Editorial production recommendation: route unknown outcomes to finance, use separate read-only reconciliation authority, and freeze new writes on timeout. The study does not validate races in real identity services or compensation through actual payment channels.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: finite deterministic conformance study; a preprint without full public reproduction. Its 336 histories cross two hosts, 14 schedules, three provider contracts and four application policies; all 168 paired host cells agree. Each host-policy combination has 42 histories: cached retry, revalidation and stable-key retry pass 30, 36 and 31 respectively. Ledger reconciliation passes 42, comprising only 21 checked completions, 15 correct denials and six unknowns. Limitations: this is not 100% task completion. Policies and checker originate in one project; there is one synthetic refund and no real IAM or payments. Full execution code is not public, although result tables are inspectable. Agreement does not identify default framework vulnerabilities. Scripted scenario frequencies are not production incident rates, and no cross-organization external validation estimates risks in actual refund traffic.
items.idea: For refund operations, rehearse recovery without real funds across three fixed interface contracts. Inject acknowledgement loss, revocation and late confirmation. Only durable receipts permit settlement; finance reviews unknowns and no automatic redispatch occurs. Measure duplicate effects, new dispatch after revocation, false completion declarations, retained uncertainty and reconciliation minutes; assign every suspended item an owner and deadline.

items.type: New safety-benchmark preprint + simulated workspaces + human-calibrated model judge
items.source: Submitted October 23, listed among new papers October 26, 2026 | Scale AI
items.title: BARC-Bench: ordinary workplace requests can cross boundaries; 27.3% is not a per-call incident rate
items.summary: BARC-Bench tests normal requests such as arranging offboarding discussions or cleaning duplicate files rather than malicious instructions. A meeting can be created successfully while a shared title prematurely discloses a departure; apparently duplicate files may preserve different resolutions. The system must infer boundaries from workspace evidence and context, not merely follow the latest instruction. The study distinguishes safe completion, harmless deferral to the user and harm already caused; later recovery cannot erase an earlier violation. For enterprises, the useful extension is from adversarial prompts to everyday collaboration errors, particularly recipients, visibility and sensitive details, rather than tool-call success alone.
items.design: Nine synthetic workspaces contain messages, calendars, documents and records. Agents retrieve evidence and use tools for an employee; task-specific rubrics define contextual harms. Four model configurations run five attempts per task. The judge reads trajectories, artifacts and final state; any harm makes the attempt unsafe. Harmless clarification without completion counts as safe, not completed. Humans review environments and calibrate the judge; they are not online takeover operators. The paper does not implement production identity isolation, field-level outbound gates or revocation recovery. Editorial recommendation: separately preview calendar titles, attachments and recipients; stop and ask on ambiguous objects or visibility instead of treating model inference as authorization.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: controlled synthetic benchmark with human-agreement checks, not independent reproduction. There are 110 tasks, four configurations and five attempts per task. All-five-harmless task shares are 72.7%, 37.3%, 23.6% and 9.1% for GPT-6 Astra, Claude-Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.8-Flash and DeepSeek V4-Pro respectively. The best configuration crosses a boundary at least once on 27.3% of tasks; this is not a 27.3% per-call incident probability. Across 300 trajectories, the judge agrees with human majority votes 90.0% of the time. Limitations: seeds were selected to induce failures; norms mainly reflect US researchers and engineers. Safety includes deferral, not completion. The paper’s data-release link remains a placeholder; an open framework is not a fully released benchmark. Models also help generate and filter tasks, potentially favoring risks they recognize. Human agreement does not establish out-of-dataset organizational norms, cross-cultural validity or multi-turn applicability.
items.idea: For administrative and HR teams, build 30 synthetic calendar and document tasks without real departure or performance data. Check completion, audience and sensitive content together; any severe leak across five repeats blocks expansion. Humans adjudicate boundaries and take over ambiguity. Track safe completion, appropriate clarification, false blocks and review effort, recording disputed cases for separate reassessment.

items.type: Engineering experiment blog + open experience-learning library + public benchmark submissions
items.title: IBM’s learned rules improve repeated customer-service success, but more memory can cost more and be less reliable
items.summary: IBM does not update model weights. It extracts short rules from successful and failed training trajectories and appends them to later conversation prompts: authenticate first, obtain explicit confirmation before a database update, and wait for tool results before replying. The original service workflow and tools remain unchanged, making the incremental effect of guidance easier to inspect. The important point is not an older model topping a leaderboard, but domain-dependent dosage: retail benefits from fuller experience, while airline tasks are more reliable with a compact high-support set. Enterprises can first turn recurring local mistakes into reviewed operating guidance rather than immediately adding Agents or training new weights.
items.design: The same GPT-4.1 extracts and consolidates training-trajectory lessons, each with support measured as distinct contributing training tasks. Guidelines are appended unchanged after policy during testing, without consulting held-out answers. A ReAct service Agent interacts with a simulated customer; order or airline tools act on the database, whose final state determines success. These rules remain prompts, not deterministic authorization gates. No real customers, production IAM, review queue or incident recovery are deployed. Editorial recommendation: limit the initial scope to return advice and refund drafts; a policy owner approves versioned guidance while formal policy retains precedence. Conflicts, failed identity checks, timeouts and uncertain advice escalate; experience must never automatically overwrite formal policy.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: vendor-controlled experiment with open code and submission records, without independent production replication. Forty held-out retail and 20 airline tasks receive four trials each. GPT-4.1 all-four success rises from 57.5% to 67.5% and from 35% to 45% respectively. In airline, 14 high-support rules achieve 45%, while all 101 reach only 40%. On the full benchmark, retail conversation cost increases from $0.084 to $0.139, or 65%, including Agent and simulated customer; this is not live service cost. Limitations: small samples, simulated customers, no confidence intervals or customer-loss outcomes. Leaderboard results use train plus test, not the held-out split. Code and PRs improve inspectability, not third-party replication; prompt-cache savings remain unvalidated in production. Rule extraction, maintenance and escalation costs must also count. Fewer turns were measured only on paired runs solved in both conditions, not evidence that all requests become faster.
items.idea: For returns-service supervisors, pilot ten retractable lessons extracted only from deidentified, human-corrected cases. A policy owner approves them for drafts. Compare no memory, ten rules and all rules on the same held-out tickets; measure all-four success, policy conflicts, incorrect refund advice, human editing time and total cost per acceptable response. Retract rules on failure.
